title: Women's 10,000m World Rankings: November 2026
desc: The top ten in World Athletics' women's 10,000m (10km) event ranking as of 10 November 2026. Values are ranking points, not race times. The event scope includes associated 10km road performances. This dated snapshot covers only the top ten, not the complete athlete population.
